final: SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS rating_avg, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) - (SELECT AVG(per_rating_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS per_rating_avg FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating) AS subq) AS above_mean FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating HAVING AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) > (SELECT AVG(per_rating_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS per_rating_avg FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating) AS subq) ORDER BY rating
